{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-3thrsy",
      "toKey": "n-1gwdti9",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The crew was at the gallery preparing a boundary (n-3thrsy) while RHOB is defined as an area name for receiving headers, not equipment (n-1gwdti9). The preparation activity occurred within the scope of that area's service.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-crpgvl"],"counterfactual":"If the crew had not been at the gallery, they would not have experienced an air-low indication during boundary preparation.","competingExplanation":"The interruption could be unrelated to their presence; however, without evidence of a simultaneous event elsewhere (n-1e02r6x), this remains plausible.","evidenceGap": "No record links crew location directly to the specific header H-R state."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-oigq1p",
      "toKey": "n-1gwdti9",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The blank temporary instruction attachment field (n-oigq1p) suggests a missing procedural safeguard that could have documented an unrecorded service-routing change or valve state affecting the receiving header H-R.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds":["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If the field had been filled with a valid temporary instruction, it might have documented any routing change or valve state.","competingExplanation":"The blank field could be due to administrative oversight unrelated to an actual hazard scenario.","evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether a service-routing change occurred without documentation."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' (n-17qciec) which aligns with the crew being at the gallery and maintenance release pending (n-2jjl7x). This condition set up the scenario for an air-low indication during work.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If boundary preparation had not been in progress, the air-low indication would have occurred outside of a work-boundary context.","competingExplanation":"The log entry could be generic and unrelated to specific valve states or pressure availability at H-R.","evidenceGap": "No record identifies which valves were open/closed during this period."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The localized pressure drop at P-R (RHOB receiving header) while upstream remained stable indicates a downstream issue affecting the crew's work area, directly impacting their ability to proceed with maintenance release.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If the pressure drop had occurred upstream, it would have affected other areas as well.","competingExplanation":"The localized issue could be due to a valve failure or blockage specific to H-R rather than systemic issues.","evidenceGap": "No record identifies which valves were open/closed during this period."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lde5sa",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Lack of documented confirmation between Utilities and RHOB about the air-low alarm (n-1lde5sa) contributed to delayed response, as no formal acknowledgment was recorded before work pause.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds":["q-8irrr9"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If confirmation had been documented, it might have accelerated the resolution process.","competingExplanation":"The lack of documentation could be due to informal communication rather than a failure in procedure.","evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether verbal or radio acknowledgment occurred."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1k72jwr",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Absence of recorded P-R reading at 09:45 AM (n-1k72jwr) means baseline pressure was not documented, complicating analysis of whether the drop was sudden or gradual.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds":["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If P-R reading had been recorded, it would provide a baseline for comparison.","competingExplanation":"The missing record could be due to sampling limitations rather than operator error.","evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether manual readings were taken."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qy43nt",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Utilities acknowledged receipt and paused work at ~10:02 AM (n-1qy43nt), indicating that the air-low indication directly caused a halt in boundary preparation activities.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If Utilities had not acknowledged receipt, work might have continued despite low pressure.","competingExplanation":"The pause could be due to procedural requirements rather than the air-low indication itself.","evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether other factors influenced the decision to pause."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-8pkzru",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Unknown specific equipment or process condition causing air-low indication (n-8pkzru) leaves open possibilities such as valve failure, blockage, or upstream disturbance affecting H-R.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds":["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If the cause were known, corrective actions could be more targeted.","competingExplanation":"The unknown condition could stem from multiple potential causes requiring further investigation.","evidenceGap": "No record identifies which specific equipment or process caused the indication."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' (n-17qciec) which aligns with the crew being at the gallery and maintenance release pending (n-2jjl7x). This condition set up the scenario for an air-low indication during work.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds":[],"counterfactual":"If boundary preparation had not been in progress, the air-low indication would have occurred outside of a work-boundary context.","competingExplanation":"The log entry could be generic and unrelated to specific valve states or pressure availability at H-R.","evidenceGap": "No record identifies which valves were open/closed during this period."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"Edges connect crew activities, procedural gaps, and localized pressure drops to the focal event of air-low indication. Supported edges rely on shift logs and pressure extracts; unknown edges highlight missing records like P-R readings or confirmation documentation.","evidenceUsed":["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],"unknowns":["n-oigq1p","n-1lde5sa","n-1k72jwr","n-8pkzru"],"alternatives":["Unrecorded service-routing change vs. administrative oversight.","Valve failure/blockage vs. upstream disturbance."],"confidence":0.6},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId\":\"req-1\",\"sourceId\":\"fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1\",\"claimRef\":\"n-k72jwr\",\"question\":\"Was a manual P-R reading recorded at 09:45 AM?\"","rationale\":\"Establish baseline pressure to determine if drop was sudden or gradual.","status\":\"pending"
    ]}
